articles.title: Attacks on maritime shipping and seafarers 'simply unacceptable': S Jaishankar
articles.description: S Jaishankar highlighted the importance of joint efforts among Indian Ocean states for enhancing maritime security and trade. articles.title: BJP Hit Out At 'Anti-Hindu Congress and TVK Over The Deepam Row After SC Bashes The TN Government
articles.description: The Karthigai Deepam controversy in Tamil Nadu has triggered a fresh political showdown, with the BJP launching a sharp attack on the Congress and Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) over the Thiruparankundram Deepam row. The BJP has accused the Congress–TVK alliance of following an "anti-Hindu" and "anti-Sanatan" agenda, questioning why the Tamil Nadu government failed to implement the Supreme Court's direction to light the traditional Karthigai Deepam at the Deepathoon stone pillar in Madurai. The controversy escalated after the lamp was lit at the customary Uchi Pillayar Mandapam instead of the disputed hilltop pillar.
